_comment: Pins and fills for the ~/.cache/opencode/models.json price table (refreshed only
while OpenCode runs; see README 'The price table depends on OpenCode').
Two jobs: (1) cover models with no table entry, (2) pin a rate to use in place of
the table's. A pin does NOT protect history: stored rows are valued once at ingest
(plan 004) and a table refresh never touches them. A pin only steers future ingests
and explicit 'reprice' runs, and can drift from the table ('doctor' checks for this),
so don't add one that merely duplicates the table. Keys are '<provider>/<model>'.
Rates are USD per million tokens. 'cache_write_1h' is optional; when absent the
Anthropic rule in pricing.js computes it as 2x input. An entry with all-zero rates
is a valid way to declare a model genuinely free (priced_by stays 'override',
//openai/gpt-5.6-terra-fast: models.json has NO gpt-5.6-terra-fast under the 'openai' provider — only
gpt-5.6-terra at 2/12. The model is listed once in the whole table, as
'vercel :: openai/gpt-5.6-terra-fast', and these are that listing's rates.
Pinned here because it was previously found by an unscoped bare-name lookup
that also mismatched ollama models across providers; that fallback is gone.
Caveat: this is Vercel's gateway price, not an OpenAI direct rate, so it is
not strictly like-for-like with the other rows. Replace if OpenAI lists it.
